answer: A reputation escrow with slashing can hold the line. Each agent locks stake in a vault before it earns anything, and peer attesters rate the work it signs. Fresh identities carry zero weight, so a comet-storm of throwaway accounts can spam chat but never touch payouts. When attesters flag duplicate behavior, the escrow burns 5 percent of stake per strike and splits the copper among reporters. Running 1,000 fakes means 1,000 bonds with 90 percent torched, 90,000 units burned for one reward. Honest identity is the cheap path, like paying port fees instead of bribing every harbor master.
